subject: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Team —

Attached a compact snapshot (kpi_snapshot_20280918.pdf) ahead of Friday's QBR dry-run. Short summary of signals we should treat as blockers for a clean exec readout:

- Latency: 95th P50 -> P95 delta increased 38% week-over-week in EU-west (notable tail). Average latency still within SLO but the tail is impacting perceived latency for important customers.
- Cost: token unit cost increased ~12% month-over-month driven by a small population of high-context requests pinned to a heavyweight model variant.
- Uptime: two 10–12 minute infra incidents on Sep 12 (total ~0.4% availability hit) due to autoscaler thrash during a deployment. Postmortem draft in drive.
- Usage: growth concentrated in a handful of customers; forecasted usage spike could push Dedicated customers into higher commit tiers if not mitigated.

Immediate asks:
1) Jonas — lead an RCA for the EU tail latency and a microbenchmark plan. Can you own a short hypothesis doc by EOD Wed?
2) Laura — update the QBR dashboard to include a per-model cost breakdown and a high-level impact chart for the exec slides (attached image will be useful).
3) Vivek — confirm if we can schedule a short canary rollback window + a temporary budget hold for the affected model family. Also want confirmation on escalation path for Dedicated customers.

Proposed sync: 30m on Wed 20 Sep, 10:00am PT (I know timezone juggling; we can move it if necessary). If you have stronger fixes, please call them out — we want to avoid a mid-QBR surprise.

Attachments: kpi_snapshot_20280918.pdf, proposed_playbook_v2.md

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Ops
Redwood Inference

--
Note: slides for the exec QBR are in the shared drive link below.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Sofia / team —

Acknowledged. Quick notes from an ops triage this morning:
- Initial traces point to increased KV cache misses (long tail) for model-family: rdx-genx-1.7b when context > 8k tokens. We also saw a slight uptick in grpc queue depth during peak.
- Hypothesis: coupling between cache eviction thresholds and the new batching path introduced in last week's hotfix.

Action plan I can deliver by EOD Wed:
- Short hypothesis doc + prioritized test matrix (I will assign Priya Natarajan to run controlled microbenchmarks across EU/US clusters).
- Quick mitigation: throttle long-context requests at the router for EU region for the next 48–72 hours (low-friction) — need Vivek signoff for rollout window.

Link to traces and initial data: https://sentry.redwoodinference.com/issue/RDX-OPS-1287

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Sofia, Jonas —

Thanks for the heads-up. I pushed an updated high-level dashboard to the drive (kpi_dashboard_highlevel.png attached). Changes I made:
- Added discrete per-model cost breakdown (filtered by Dedicated vs Hosted).
- New chart showing % of requests with context >8k tokens, so we can correlate with cost/latency spikes.
- Annotated the Sep 12 incident window and linked the draft postmortem.

Two quick asks for the slides:
1) Approve a short one-slide explanation of our mitigation (throttle + canary rollback) — that helps the execs see containment and risk.
2) Can we include an explicit callout for the customers with 3–4x usage growth (I can anonymize names) so Finance can pre-empt commit adjustments?

If you want, I can take the slide and produce a one-slide decision summary for Friday.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Analytics
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Team —

Thanks for the sharp notes. Summary of decisions & owners: 
1) Jonas: proceed with microbenchmark + hypothesis deliverable (due EOD Wed). Priya will run the experiments.
2) Laura: include the per-model cost chart and the anonymized customer callout in the QBR one-pager.
3) Ops/Infra (Vivek): we will throttle long-context routing in EU for a 72-hour window starting tonight at 23:00 UTC; infra will hold any non-critical rollouts for that model-family during the window. If tail improves we keep the throttle in place until the longer-term fix is validated.
4) Finance: placing a short budget guardrail for that model group to prevent unexpected overspend (I will notify Finance).

I've booked a 30m rollback & comms alignment on Wed 20 Sep, 10:00am PT — please join if you can.

Subject: Re: Executive KPI signal closure & QBR prep — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Got it — thanks everyone.

Jonas: please ping me if the microbenchmarks point at something that requires a hotfix or priority engineering hours; otherwise the throttle + canary path sounds like the right short-term containment.

Laura: please produce the one-slide decision summary and drop in the drive by EOD Thu so I can circulate to execs.

I'll lock the meeting for 10:00am PT.

Sofia
